decision_conditions:
The application site is located on Stroud Green Road, adjacent to Finsbury Park Station to the northeast of the London Borough of Islington located directly adjacent to the borough boundary. 

The proposed Pole A would be located within the London Borough of Haringey which would be connected to Pole B which is within Islington via clear nylon filament. A live planning application (App REF P2025/2352/FUL) has been submitted to the Council pending assessment to cover Pole A.

Whilst the Council raise no objection with no substantive comments on the proposal. Officers would like to raise a technical error with the drawings, in that the submission pack appears to show Pole B, but not Pole A which is within the London Borough of Haringey. Permission can only be granted for development within the borough where permission is requested to be approved. Officers would recommend that the submission pack is amended to detail and clearly show Location A.

It should be noted also that in the submitted application HGY/2025/2238 Pole B is marked as 33.2, whereas it is marked as 33.1 (as shown in the Islington submission).

description: Installation of street furniture comprising pairs of 76mm diameter steel tubes (poles) linked with 1.6mm clear nylon filament and similar street furniture to delineate a local Jewish Eruv.
